# Tier `ampere-2x16`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda-pair` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 131072 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 131072 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen38-27b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ3_S.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |
| `timestral-209m` | forecast | `forecast_model` | `timestral-209m` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

It ships no file-backed media seed, so `generate_image` / `generate_video` /
`generate_audio` / `run_graph` report `NOT CONFIGURED` until an operator binds them.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_max_tokens` | `1024` |
| `agent_model` | `qwen3.5-4b-agent` |
| `agent_profile` | `research` |
| `escalation_model` | `` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` | `1` |
| `reasoning_model` | `` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Two identical 16 GB Ampere cards (2x NVIDIA A2, sm_86, 15,356 MiB each, no NVLink) on a small-form-factor desktop, served as PIN, DON'T SPLIT: every model fits one card and is pinned whole to it (llama-swap.linux-cuda-pair.yaml). HEAVY card: the Qwen3.8-27B agent (UD-IQ3_S) and the vision seat, one 12 GB model at a time. UTILITY card: the memory stack (embeddinggemma, reranker), STT, the forecaster, and the cascade (e4b | e2b | the 4B agent) as alternatives; the `both` set runs the cascade beside the 27B. Card roles are a render-time choice, not a profile field: `install render --heavy-card N [--utility-card M]` (a CUDA index or a GPU-<uuid>; default heavy 0, utility 1; install.sh takes the same flags and OFFLOAD_HEAVY_CARD / OFFLOAD_UTILITY_CARD). Indices follow CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID, which gpu_env sets on every entry. The heavy card is a per-box choice because the two slots are not equal: on the reference box card 0 (CPU-lane slot, 60 W) was thermally limited by its chassis fan header, a host airflow fault and not a tier property, so the 27B ran on card 1 (chipset x4 slot, held at a 35 W floor) and its figures are a LOWER BOUND; a box with sound airflow renders heavy 0. MEASURED 2026-11-07 on that box (llama.cpp b12192 sm_86 CUDA 13.4, llama-swap v270): the 27B agent pinned to the 35 W card, 13,956 MiB, 8.4 tok/s generation and 42.5 tok/s prompt on a short prompt; offload-e4b 4,430 MiB plus embeddinggemma 452 MiB concurrently on the other card; whisper large-v3-turbo on CUDA 1,624 MB, an 11 s clip transcribed exactly in 6.7 s wall cold; timestral-209m 54.5 ms model wall, 934 MiB; every seat unloaded at ttl 300 (both cards back to 0 MiB, P8); doctor rc 0, acceptance READY. Ctx 131072 q8_0 for the cascade and the 4B, 49152 literal for the 27B (the single-A2 fit, ampere-16). include_26b is false and moe_26b drops it: the 26B measured 1/8 on the A2 (ampere-16). The agent seat is the 4B, as on ampere-16. PROJECTED, not measured on this tier: the vision seat (it is the ampere-16 bake-off's winner on the same silicon, never run on the two-card box), the 27B as the default agent binding, any concurrent load of the heavy seat with the cascade under real traffic, host RAM 32 GB (the reference box has 16 GB, ram tier min; at 32 GB it becomes low). No vLLM seat: no two-card vLLM measurement and no venv on the reference box (the ampere-16 vLLM seat is single-card, device 0). No comfy, image or video keys: the reference box has no ComfyUI install, so no image or video lane is declared until one is measured on this tier. Linux only (no Windows cuda-pair template); classification is gated to Linux.
